sample_unit: persons with a positive fecal immunochemical test

links.outcome: Advanced colorectal neoplasia detection rate with vs without computer-aided detection
links.effect: No significant difference in advanced neoplasia detection (34.8% vs 34.6%; aRR 1.01 [95% CI 0.92 to 1.10]); adenoma detection rate also did not differ (64.2% vs 62.0%).
links.quote: Computer-aided detection did not improve colonoscopic identification of advanced colorectal neoplasias.

screen.reason: Multicenter randomized controlled trial evaluating the clinical impact of computer-aided detection (CADe) during real colonoscopies compared to standard care (testing the tool itself, not a specific deployment guardrail or practice).
